## Tip-Jokes Experiment Data {.unnumbered}


### Description

Data from Gueguen (2002) examining whether a waiter leaving a joke
or an advertisement on a card affects tipping behavior.



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>tip_jokes
</code></pre>


### Format

A data frame with variables:


<dl>
<dt>card</dt><dd>Type of card: Advertisement (1), Joke (2), None (3)
</dd>
<dt>tip</dt><dd>Whether customer left a tip: No (0), Yes (1)
</dd>
<dt>ad</dt><dd>Indicator for ad card: 0/1
</dd>
<dt>joke</dt><dd>Indicator for joke card: 0/1
</dd>
<dt>none</dt><dd>Indicator for no card: 0/1
</dd>
</dl>



### Source

Gueguen, N. (2002). Journal of Applied Social Psychology.
